tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// yi gyang jus glegs bam bsgrubs pa la bsngags pa bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo gu ru ratna tra yā ya/ dpal kun gyi ni 'byung gnas te// nyes pa thams cad drung nas 'byin// che ba'i che bas cher mchod pa// sangs rgyas dpal gyi phul la 'dud// khyod kyi legs bshad seng ge'i sgra// sems can grangs bzhin pha mtha' yas// 'on kyang gdul bya'i dbang byas nas// sdud pos nges pa bzhin du bsdus// tshul de 'phags pa'i yul nas ni// yul gzhan dag tu'ang gsal bar gyur// khyad par thub pa nongs nas lo// stong nas brtsams te rgya yul du// mdo dang dgongs 'grel de 'grel bcas// rim pa bzhin du bsgyur ba rnams// skyes mchog rnams kyis yi ge'i rgyar// bsgrubs nas btab pa'i glegs bam tshogs// rgya nag chen por bzhugs mod kyang*// si tshon la sogs yul gzhan du// sngon chad rdzogs par mi bzhugs pa// de bzhugs pa dang rgyas bya'i phyir// hor gyi dbang byas te'u ca'o la// dbang bsgyur dbang po lnga pa ni// yon tan sna tshogs lon pa ste// de ming rgyal po gan zhes bya// de yi ring la ji wan nas// brtsams te lo bdun lon pa'i lor// chos rje sa skya pa yi 'bangs// 'phags pa ti shri'i slob ma ni// si tshon yul du skyes gyur zhing*// chos la blo gros legs sbyangs pa// rgya dang bod dang bal po dang*// rgya gar sogs kyi rten mchog dang*// mkhas pa'i mchog rnams legs mthong zhing*// de dag rnams kyi drin thob nas// drin la lan du ldon 'dod pa// yi gyang ju zhes bya ba yis// par la glegs bam yongs rdzogs par// bsgrubs nas don chen legs par bsgrubs// 'di yi dge bas chos tshul 'di// cig car kun tu rgyas gyur cig /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'ang 'grub par shog /rgyal po yun ring gnas gyur cig /rgyal srid chos bzhin skyong bar shog /rgyal khams dag kyang bde gyur cig

/yi ge 'di ni yi gyang jus// yang dang yang du rab bskul nas// dge slong 'phags pas dge ba'i blos// sdeb sbyor rnam par sbyar 'di sdebs// phyogs dang dus thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
